Participation Registration

Choose Your Participation Pathway

Please review the options below and select the pathway that best applies to you before continuing to registration.

💛

Financial Supporter

Choose this pathway if you wish to support Pangu through a voluntary financial contribution.

Please note: Financial contributions are voluntary and do not guarantee employment, appointment, endorsement, preferential treatment, event access, contracts, or any political or commercial benefit.

🤝

Sponsor / Pangu 200

Choose this pathway if you are an individual, business, or organisation interested in formal sponsorship or partnership opportunities under the Pangu 200 pathway.

Please note: Submitting this form expresses interest in sponsorship only. Sponsorship is subject to approval, package confirmation, and completion of the required process.

✋

Volunteer Supporter

Choose this pathway if you wish to support Pangu by offering your time, skills, and practical assistance during approved party activities, events, or community engagement.

Please note: Volunteer support is unpaid and does not guarantee employment, allowances, transport, accommodation, meals, gifts, endorsement, appointment, or future paid engagement.

Continue to Registration → Button activates once the acknowledgement is selected.
